buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Strict Hardware Parameters: The offered Analog Trunk System must strictly com ply with all technical specifications mentioned in the tender. 2. Genuine & Unused Material: All equipment supplied must be 100% brand new, original, unused, and of standard commercial quality. Refurbished, duplicate, or repa ired equipment will be rejected and returned at the bidder's cost. 3. Requirement of Sample for Physical Verification: To verify technical parame ters (such as port capacity, build quality, and specially the 8-hour battery backup and power supply performance), the buyer/consignee reserves the right to demand a phy sical sample or demonstration from the lowest/participating bidders prior to final tec hnical clearance or order placement.

4. Sample Testing Timeline: The requested sample must be provided by the bidde r within the stipulated timeframe (e.g., 7 to 10 days of notice) at the designated insp ection site at the bidders own cost. 5. Failure in Sample Battery Backup Test: If during physical sample inspection/t esting, the offered systems power supply / SMPS fails to deliver or support the mand atory MINIMUM 8 HOURS BATTERY BACKUP, the bid/vendor will be summarily disqualified and rejected. 6. Free Delivery, Installation & Final Testing: The Bidder shall complete fu ll installation, trunk/extension testing, and live 8-hour battery backup testing at the c onsignee site without any additional charge. 7. Payment Release Condition: 100% payment will be released only after complet e supply, successful site installation, successful post-supply inspection/testing of 8-ho ur battery backup, and issuance of the final acceptance certificate by the buyer. .
